[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Recover staged handoffs without repeating adoption[/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]after their obligations are satisfied.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Define durable recovery identity and replay decisions[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]recovery-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery-contract: add Rust-owned recovery contracts and replay [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decisions, persist the original execution context, and serialize [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adoption across runner, manual recovery, and housekeeping callers. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Preserve existing receipt formats.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Recover pipe and inline successors exactly once[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]successor-replay[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recovery-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]successor-replay: persist successor identity before continuation side [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]effects, replay pipe adoption without allocating another successor, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]provide the common detached continuation path used when the original [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runner is gone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Replay plan and question approval handoffs[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]approval-replay[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recovery-contract, successor-replay[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]approval-replay: bind plan and question gates to staged identity, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recover original creator and approval context without ambient agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]variables, and replay both human-gated and auto-resolved continuations.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Complete partially published gates on replay[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gate-replay[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recovery-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-replay: resume partial gate publication under its existing request [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and member identities, repairing claim and notification effects without [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]duplicating the gate or changing its frozen creator and policy.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Close monitor spawn and held-reservation crash windows[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]monitor-replay[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recovery-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor-replay: recover monitor launch from existing fingerprint and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]proc identities, including completed commands, and retain or safely [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]restore held reservations and prepared completion evidence across [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]retries.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopt from persisted state and preserve finalizer progress[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]recovery-service[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recovery-contract, successor-replay, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]approval-replay, gate-replay, monitor-replay[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery-service: expose one host recovery entry point for all kinds, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prove settlement from the original run and current obligations, preserve[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]successful multi-repository commit receipts, and replay held handoffs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after valid repair.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Expose re-adoption and actionable held notifications[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]readopt-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recovery-service[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]readopt-cli: add sase agent readopt for one unambiguous originating [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]turn, render recovery results and refusals, and include the exact [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]command in held handoff notifications and focused user documentation.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reconcile abandoned finalized stages and verify crash recovery[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]reconcile-stages[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recovery-service, readopt-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile-stages: add bounded scheduler housekeeping for finalized [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]staged turns whose runner is gone, coordinate it with claim cleanup, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]verify concurrent recovery and crash boundaries across all handoff [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kinds.[/#D7D7AF]
